title: Equality
definition: Two expressions are equal when they name the same thing, so either can replace the other in any statement.

title: Number
definition: A number says how many or how much, and numbers can be counted, compared and combined by arithmetic.

title: Set
definition: A set is a collection of distinct things treated as one object and defined by which things belong to it.

title: Function
definition: A function assigns to each input exactly one output.

title: Measurement
definition: A measurement compares a quantity with a chosen unit and reports the ratio as a number.
